Security evidence:

Noncanonical seats or F132-unprintable instances omit the entire entry; prime designation rows are excluded. Shell metacharacters cannot become executable command syntax (crates/daemon/src/delivery/role_send.rs:298-309,386-418; crates/daemon/src/community/picture.rs:98-104; crates/core/src/directory.rs:32-42).
- The reason is returned to the sender in its receipt, not added to another seat's message. Sender attribution is unchanged; forwarded/remote role sends remain refused (crates/daemon/src/http/role_send.rs:92-105,130-175).
- Assignments are selected using the bound project parameter, then the addressed role and instance. The disclosed holding identifiers and release commands are already visible through that project's directory; the addition introduces no cross-project lookup or new information-access authority (crates/store/src/community.rs:362-373; crates/daemon/src/community/directory.rs:471-495).
